newsitem.title: USA: Indiana minister and wife found bound and slain.
newsitem.headline: Indiana minister and wife found bound and slain.

text.p: A Presbyterian minister and his wife were brutally slain with an axe and left beneath their Christmas tree and their house was set ablaze, police said Monday.
Police believe the Rev. Frederick Mathias and his wife Cleta, both 64, may have surprised an intruder or may have been followed home from church services on Sunday evening when they were attacked.

Firefighters responding to a fire set on the upper floor found their bodies near the tree, in the rear of their upscale home, with their hands bound. "It's a bizarre case," Marion County Sheriff's Deputy Mike Russo said, calling the slayings "especially brutal."
Friends said Mathias planned to retire soon and move to the East Coast where the couple's three grown children lived.
